title: Sunday · the ridge, no glow
logline: The ridge east of town in November, drawn straight: trees, cloud, nothing above them. The strip draws it four years before 'Lanes' so the reader can go back and check.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the forested ridge from the estuary in November, cloud sitting on it, the trees gray-green, the sky the same gray. Nothing above the treeline.

image.prompt: a forested ridge under low November cloud seen across an estuary, gray-green, nothing unusual above the treeline, no words
image.notes: No glow. On purpose. Compare dw_2009-03-08.
